# Advanced wasteland remedies
Some recipes require scavenged or separately prepared precursors. A catalyst must be present but is not consumed; separate it from the finished medicine before use.
## Antibiotics
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u penicillin + 2u Antiseptic + 1u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u antibiotics.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Disease treatment is not implemented. Currently it can cause vomiting; it does not cure infections. ## Radshield
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u Antiseptic + 1u water + 2u irradiated fungus extract + 3u rad-x + 1u uranium (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 6u radshield.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Applies incoming radiation protection; At 25u or more: Causes poison damage. ## X-111 compound
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u radaway + 1u rad-x + 1u hyronalin + 1u Promethine + 1u refined antidote + 1u uranium (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 434 K (160.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u x-111 compound.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression. ## Blood shield
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u cactus water + 1u fungus extract + 1u broc flower extract
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u blood shield.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, poison damage. ## Datura hide
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u datura extract + 1u Wonderglue
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u datura hide.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes heat damage; Applies incoming damage protection. ## Snakebite tourniquet
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u buffalo gourd juice + 1u Antiseptic
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u snakebite tourniquet.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes cazador venom in the body; Removes nightstalker venom in the body; Removes ash viper venom in the body; Removes fire toxin in the body; Heals poison damage; Reduces bleeding. ## Fiery purgative
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u vodka + 1u glowpepper juice + 1u white horsenettle extract
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u fiery purgative.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison, radiation damage; Causes heat damage; Removes cazador venom in the body; Removes nightstalker venom in the body; Removes ash viper venom in the body; Reduces movement speed; Can cause vomiting. ## Refreshing beverage
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u Antiseptic + 3u blood + 2u water + 3u radaway + 2u super stimpak + 1u refined antidote
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 9u refreshing beverage.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, airloss, poison, radiation damage; Reduces bleeding; Reduces feralization progression; Suppresses addiction. ## Glowing blood pack
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u blood + 2u Antiseptic + 1u rad-x + 1u uranium (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u glowing blood pack.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, asphyxiation, bloodloss damage; Applies incoming radiation protection. ## Herbal anodyne
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u carrot juice + 1u irradiated fungus extract + 2u nettle juice + 1u razorgrain flour + 2u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 8u herbal anodyne.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Suppresses chronic pain; Removes drowsiness. ## Herbal antimicrobial
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u carrot juice + 1u irradiated fungus extract + 2u buffalo gourd juice + 1u nettle juice + 2u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 7u herbal antimicrobial.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals poison damage. ## Herbal stimulant
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u irradiated fungus extract + 1u buffalo gourd juice + 1u nettle juice + 2u razorgrain flour + 2u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 7u herbal stimulant.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes drowsiness; Increases movement speed. ## Skeeto spit
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u blood + 2u broc flower extract + 1u silicon + 1u iron + 1u epinephrine
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 5u skeeto spit.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Temporarily modifies SPECIAL stats (Endurance +2). ## Penicillin
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u fungus extract + 1u sugar + 1u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u penicillin.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Disease treatment is not implemented. Currently it can cause vomiting; it does not cure infections. ## Prussian blue
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u iron + 2u carbon + 2u nitrogen + 1u hyronalin
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 340 K (66.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u prussian blue.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals radiation damage; Reduces feralization progression. ## Pilgrim's remedy
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u agave nectar extract + 1u broc flower extract + 1u xander extract + 1u fungus extract + 1u water
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 5u pilgrim's remedy.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn, poison, radiation damage; Increases bleeding; Reduces feralization progression. ## Healing salve
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u broc flower extract + 1u xander extract + 1u agave nectar extract + 1u water
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 330 K (56.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u healing salve.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Heals brute, burn damage; Reduces bleeding. ## Lazarus compound
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u epinephrine + 2u epoetine + 2u super stimpak + 2u refined antidote + 1u phalanximine + 1u hyronalin + 2u Promethine + 1u Berserker Mixture + 1u Black Goo
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 374 K (100.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 10u lazarus compound.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] While critically injured: Heals brute, burn, airloss, poison damage; While critically injured: Reduces bleeding; Causes cellular, poison damage; Causes jittering; At 12u or more: Causes cellular, poison damage. ## Widowbane
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u refined antidote + 2u tarberry juice + 1u widow's mercy (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u widowbane.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes widow's mercy in the body; Heals poison, airloss damage; Can cause vomiting. ## Cinder serum
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u refined antidote + 2u cactus water + 1u red bell poison (catalyst; retained)
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u cinder serum.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes red bell poison in the body; Heals poison, asphyxiation damage; Causes jittering. ## Gravesalt
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u refined antidote + 2u table salt + 1u ammonia
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 354 K (80.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 4u gravesalt.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Removes ghostcap extract in the body; Removes widow's mercy in the body; Removes red bell poison in the body; Removes ash viper venom in the body; Removes cazador venom in the body; Removes nightstalker venom in the body; Heals poison, asphyxiation damage; Causes brute damage; Can cause vomiting. ## Promethine
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 3u radaway + 2u rad-x + 2u epinephrine + 1u phosphorus + 1u silicon
[bold]Heat:[/bold] at least 320 K (46.85 C).
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 5u Promethine.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] At 5u or more: Can reverse eligible recent ghoulification; Reduces feralization progression.
